sections.Description:
On this pinball adventure, players will transform into their favorite Super Heroes as they battle Thanos and his minions across the cosmos.

On his unrelenting quest for intergalactic omnipotent power, it’s a race to hunt down and recover the six Infinity Gems before Thanos gets his hands on them. It’s up to the player to stop Thanos and the Black Order from succeeding in this action-packed pinball experience.
sections.Gameplay Features:
- Open Portals: Shoot the interactive Dr. Strange spinning kinetic sling ring disc with dual direction velocity detection, aiding players on their journey to opening portals and starting Infinity Gem quests.
- Defy Gravity: Featuring a gravity defying Avengers Tower magnetic lock ramp with gravitational vari-target and magnet hold, capturing pinballs in midair as players unlock Iron Man Multiball.
- Custom Wireform Ramps: Custom intricate wireform ramps featuring a Captain Marvel inverse gravity wireform ramp, and a Pym Laboratories vertical up-kicker.
sections.Editions:
Pro:
- Pro model features Avengers Heroes Unite themed full color translite and unique side cabinet hand-drawn artwork by Zombie Yeti.
- Stereo sound system with 3-channel amplifier with separate treble and bass adjustment.
- Incredible rendered LCD graphical scenes with 22 RGB software controlled LEDs.

Premium:
- Premium model features Black Order themed full color translite and unique side cabinet hand-drawn artwork by Zombie Yeti.
- Powder-coated steel bottom arch with Powder-coated black wrinkle finish side armor, hinges, front lockdown molding and legs.
- Custom sculpted Thanos Infinity Gauntlet integrated with atmospheric light-up gems.

Limited Edition:
- Limited Edition mirrored backglass with stunning and distinctive high definition hand-drawn artwork by Zombie Yeti.
- Designer Autographed collectible featuring signature of game designer Keith Elwin.
- Interactive Speaker Expression Lighting System with and 3-channel amplifier and tweeter for enhanced fidelity.
